'''Paradise Lost''' is the 49th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on August 26, 2022. The set consists of 37 cards. 

==Type Breakdown==
*1 [[:Category:Artifact (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Artifact]]
*2 [[:Category:Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Dilemma]]
*2 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]]
*2 [[:Category:Facility (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Facility]] (1 Federation)
*3 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
*2 [[:Category:Interrupt (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Interrupt]]
*3 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]
*1 [[:Category:Objective (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Objective]]
*15 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] ( 5 Federation, 1 Klingon, and 9 Non-Aligned)
*4 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (2 Federation, and 4 Non-Aligned)
*2 [[:Category:Tactic (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Tactic]]

'''NOTE:''' There are 2 Dual Affiliations cards, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.

==Rarity Breakdown==
*37 [[:Category:Virtual (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Virtual]]
